posts.title: Tesla's China retail sales fall 12.4% in August, marking third straight decline
posts.summary:
Tesla's China retail sales totaled 50,047 vehicles in August, with sales for the first 8 months down 12.44%.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Tesla's China retail sales fell 12.43% year-on-year to 50,047 units in August, marking the third consecutive month of decline.
The Shanghai factory's export volume continues to outpace domestic retail sales, with cumulative exports up 114.7% year-to-date.
Tesla's share of the Chinese BEV market has compressed to 7.17%, down from 8.33% a year ago, reflecting increased competition from domestic manufacturers.
The company has implemented new cash incentives for the third quarter to stimulate domestic demand amid persistent retail sales pressure.

posts.title: China's August NEV retail sales fall 10%, but penetration hits record 65.2%
posts.summary:
China's NEV retail sales fell 10.1% year-on-year to 1.005 million in August, marking the eighth consecutive month of decline.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: China's NEV retail sales fell 10.1% year-on-year to 1.005 million units in August, marking the eighth consecutive month of decline.
Despite the retail sales drop, NEV market penetration reached a record 65.2% as gasoline car sales experienced a sharper contraction.
NEV exports remain a critical growth driver, surging 154.7% year-on-year and accounting for 58.4% of total passenger car exports.
BYD maintains market dominance with 233,943 retail sales, followed by Geely and Leapmotor, while Tesla ranked sixth.

posts.title: VW Anhui refreshes ID. UNYX 08 SUV with lower prices just 5 months after launch
posts.summary:
The updated ID. UNYX 08 starts at a limited-time price of 189,900 yuan ($28,030), 17.4% below its starting price at its April launch.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Volkswagen Anhui has aggressively cut the starting price of the ID. UNYX 08 by 17.4% to 189,900 yuan, just five months after its initial market launch.
The price adjustment follows sluggish sales performance, with CPCA data reporting only 133 units sold in July and 379 units in August.
The vehicle leverages Xpeng's advanced technology stack, featuring dual Turing AI chips for 1,500 TOPS of computing power and the VLA 2.0 driver-assistance system.
Despite the price reduction, the technical specifications remain robust, utilizing an 800-volt platform and CATL LFP batteries capable of 10% to 80% charging in approximately 20 minutes.

posts.title: Smart Outlier Detection
posts.summary:
Just because a chip is deemed good doesn't mean it will work as expected.
The post Smart Outlier Detection appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Leading-edge multi-die assemblies require a shift from rigid pass/fail testing to context-aware outlier detection to prevent field failures.
Machine learning models are being deployed to assess die usefulness based on real-world workload behavior rather than static specifications.
Effective outlier detection can significantly optimize power, performance, and area (PPA) while reducing the scrap rates associated with overly conservative testing.

posts.title: This founder is making cheaper, cleaner steel
posts.summary: The steel industry isn’t exactly known for innovation. Very little has changed about purifying iron ore since the process was invented and commercialized in the 1850s. The majority of steelmakers melt solid iron ore at dizzyingly high temperatures inside blast furnaces, where the material reacts with gases to trigger chemical reactions that remove oxygen. It…
bullets: Hertha Metals has developed a single-step furnace process that replaces coal with natural gas to refine iron ore into liquid steel.
The technology claims to reduce carbon emissions by at least 50% while simultaneously cutting production costs by 25% compared to traditional blast furnace methods.
Given that steel production accounts for roughly 7% of global carbon emissions, this innovation offers a scalable path to decarbonization that aligns with the industry's tight profit margins.
